assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the basic needs of all living things, such as air, food, water, and shelter
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions food as a source of energy for athletes, but does not teach the concept of basic needs of all living things (air, food, water, shelter). It focuses on nutrition and energy for performance, not identifying basic needs.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: vitamins help the body work, but food gives the energy

assignedReviews.reason: The card touches on how food provides energy and vitamins help the body, but it does not describe how any human body system (muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, respiratory) works. It is about diet and energy, not system function.

copy.en: Even athletes who take vitamins still need to eat plenty of carbs before playing—vitamins help the body work, but food gives the energy to run and jump.
copy.tl: Kahit ang mga atletang umiinom ng bitamina ay kailangan pa ring kumain ng maraming carbohydrates bago maglaro—ang bitamina ay tumutulong sa katawan pero ang pagkain ang nagbibigay ng enerhiya.
copy.bis: Bisan ang mga atleta nga nag-inom og bitamina kinahanglan gihapon mokaon og daghang carbohydrates una magdula—ang bitamina motabang sa lawas apan ang pagkaon ang naghatag og kusog.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Protein is like bricks that build and repair your body
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the basic needs of all living things, such as air, food, water, and shelter
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains the roles of protein and vitamins as nutrients, but does not address the basic needs of living things (air, food, water, shelter) as required by G3-L-6. It shares the broad topic of food/nutrition but provides no direct instructional support for identifying basic needs.

copy.en: Protein is like bricks that build and repair your body and can also become energy. Vitamins aren't bricks or energy — they're just helpers keeping everything running.
copy.tl: Ang protina ay parang ladrilyo na ginagamit para magtayo at mag-ayos ng katawan, at puwede ring gawing enerhiya. Ang bitamina naman ay hindi ladrilyo at hindi enerhiya—katuwang lang ito para gumana ang lahat.
copy.bis: Ang protina sama sa tisa nga gigamit para tukuron ug ayohon ang lawas, ug pwede sab himuong kusog. Ang bitamina, dili tisa ug dili kusog—katabang ra kini nga motabang aron molihok ang tanan.

copy.en:
What is a volcanic plug?

It's solidified magma that hardened inside a volcano's central vent! When erosion washes away the softer outer rock, the harder plug remains as a dramatic rock pillar.
copy.tl:
Ano ang volcanic plug?

Ito ay solidified magma na tumigas sa loob ng central vent ng bulkan! Kapag inalis ng erosion ang mas malambot na panlabas na bato, nananatili ang mas matigas na plug bilang rock pillar.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang volcanic plug?

Kini ang solidified magma nga nagtigas sulod sa central vent sa bulkan! Kon ang mas humok nga gawas nga bato tangtangon sa erosion, ang mas gahi nga plug nagpabilin ingon nga rock pillar.

copy.en: Volcanic rocks differ in silica content and color! Basalt has low silica and is dark. Andesite has moderate silica and is grey. Rhyolite has high silica, is light-colored, and has very explosive eruptions!
copy.tl: Nagkakaiba ang volcanic rocks sa silica content at kulay! Ang basalt ay mababa ang silica at madilim. Ang andesite ay katamtaman ang silica at abo-abo. Ang rhyolite ay mataas ang silica, maliwanag, at napaka-explosive!
copy.bis: Nagkalain ang volcanic rocks sa silica content ug kolor! Ang basalt ubos ang silica ug ngitngit. Ang andesite katamtaman ang silica ug abo-abo. Ang rhyolite taas ang silica, hayag, ug grabe ka explosive!

copy.en: In the Philippines, PHIVOLCS watches active volcanoes! They use machines to sense earthquakes and measure gas, then issue an alert level to tell us how dangerous it is.
copy.tl: Sa Pilipinas, binabantayan ng PHIVOLCS ang mga aktibong bulkan! Gumagamit sila ng machines para sa lindol at gas, at naglalabas ng alert level para alam natin ang danger.
copy.bis: Sa Pilipinas, gibantayan sa PHIVOLCS ang aktibo nga bulkan! Naggamit sila og machines para sa linog ug gas, ug mag-isyu og alert level aron mahibal-an nato ang danger.

assignedReviews.reason: The card explains the meaning of PHIVOLCS alert levels (higher number = nearer/stronger eruption), which is background needed to interpret the scale, but it does not teach what to do before, during, and after a volcanic eruption, which is the core action of the competency.

copy.en: PHIVOLCS uses alert levels from 0 to 5 to show a volcano's danger. A higher number means a nearer or stronger eruption!
copy.tl: Gumagamit ang PHIVOLCS ng alert levels mula 0 hanggang 5 para sa kapanganiban ng bulkan. Mas mataas ang numero, mas malapit o malakas ang pagputok!
copy.bis: Naggamit ang PHIVOLCS og alert levels gikan sa 0 hangtod 5 para sa kahimtang sa bulkan. Mas taas ang numero, mas duol o kusog ang pagbuto!
